en: Colorized vintage postcard view across the Bosphorus showing an ornate waterfront palace with elaborate neoclassical-Ottoman architecture, identified in French as the Beylerbeyi Palace in Constantinople. The building stands behind a long sea wall with the water in the foreground and hilly, tree-covered land in the background. Printed caption text appears at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.
